from pathlib import Path
content = """# ============================================================
AnujBotz | Premium GitHub Contribution Snake
Generates an animated contribution graph and publishes it
to the output branch for use in your profile README.
============================================================
name: "🐍 Generate Contribution Snake"
on:
Refresh daily at 00:00 UTC
schedule: - cron: "0 0 * * *"
Allow manual runs from the Actions tab
workflow_dispatch:
Regenerate whenever the main branch changes
push: branches: - main
Grant only the permission needed to publish the generated SVG.
permissions: contents: write
Prevent overlapping runs from publishing at the same time.
concurrency: group: contribution-snake cancel-in-progress: true
jobs: generate: name: Generate and publish SVG runs-on: ubuntu-latest timeout-minutes: 10
steps:
  - name: "🐍 Generate contribution snake"
    uses: Platane/snk/svg-only@v3
    with:
      github_user_name: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
      outputs: |
        dist/github-contribution-grid-snake.svg?palette=github-dark&color_snake=%2338BDF8&color_dots=%230D1117%2C%230C4A6E%2C%230369A1%2C%230EA5E9%2C%237DD3FC

  - name: "🚀 Publish SVG to output branch"
    uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v3.1.0
    with:
      target_branch: output
      build_dir: dist
      commit_message: "chore: update contribution snake animation"
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
"""
out = Path("/mnt/data/snake.yml") out.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8") print(f"Created: {out}")
